_comment: Product repositories. Read-only sources of product knowledge. Discovered 2026-10-21 via the account's repository list; classification from README content — confirm 'needs_confirmation' entries.

products.name: MasjidOne
products.notes: B2B SaaS for masājid/madrasahs. Has pricing and a live website.

brand.tone: Plain-spoken, candid and community-minded, careful never to overclaim and respectful of Islamic terminology.

target_audience: UK masjid with an evening madrasah
Islamic centre running classes and a congregation app

products.name: Domi
products.notes: B2B SaaS for home-visit healthcare. Working demo, no customers yet.

brand.tone: Plain-spoken, practical and scrupulously honest about what is and isn't built, written for busy home-visit practices in British English.

products.name: Booked In
products.notes: Booking page for solo beauty professionals. README: not provisioned (no live email/payments).

brand.tone: Warm, plain-spoken and candid, written in British English for working beauty professionals rather than technologists, and careful never to oversell.

target_audience: Solo lash technicians taking bookings by Instagram DM
Mobile and home-studio beauty pros (nails, brows) working alone

products.name: Tidemark
products.notes: B2C iPhone weight tracker. Not yet on the App Store.

brand.tone: Plain-spoken, calm and candid: it explains what the app does and doesn't do, avoids hype and refuses to scold.

target_audience: Privacy-minded iPhone users who weigh in regularly
People who want the trend rather than the daily number

products.name: Bolton Vouched
products.notes: Local tradespeople directory for Bolton (confirmed in scope by owner 2026-10-21).
products.screenshots_note: Live listings show real tradespeople's names and numbers; they consented to a listing, not to appearing in ads.

brand.tone: Warm, neighbourly and plain-spoken, written in British English and scrupulously honest about what is built, what is coming and what is never for sale.

target_audience: Bolton residents looking for a recommended local tradesperson
Bolton tradespeople recommended in the WhatsApp group (recruited personally, not marketed to)

products.name: YSB Designs (agency)
products.notes: Agency portfolio — services, not a SaaS. Enable if you want agency marketing.
